digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` must be neutral in scope inheritance and not poison sibling path declarations
Container attestation must inherit only declared paths from live children and classify all-none only when all live children are authenticated `none`
Any live undeclared child must poison child path inheritance and prevent whole-container all-none classification
Plan-review P9 must pass leaves and containers with only declared-none or declared-paths children, and advise only live undeclared children with both path-declaration and `--none` remedies
Cheap resign must preserve child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads
Parent-owned paths must take precedence over all-none children and not synthesize file-scope:none markers
